about: The tools Flurry may call when answering a question about one project. Read tools only read that project's records, as the person asking may see them. Proposal tools never change anything: they become suggestions the person reviews and confirms in the app. The same file drives the backend (dev.projectflow.ai.ToolCatalog) and the tool-calling eval (ml/niveloft_ml/tooleval.py, run with python -m niveloft_ml tools).

tools.name: find_tasks
tools.description: Find tasks in this project by words in their title or description, and/or by status, owner or lateness. Returns up to 15 tasks: key, title, status, owner and due date.

query.description: Words to look for in titles and descriptions. Leave out to list by the filters only.

assignee.description: Only tasks owned by this person (their name), or 'unassigned'.

overdue.description: Only unfinished tasks past their due date.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Everything recorded about one task: its description, acceptance criteria, checklist, what it waits on and what waits on it, every submission and review decision, and its latest comments.

key.description: The task's key, for example ONB-9.

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: All comments on one task, oldest first (up to 30), with who wrote each and when.

key.description: The task's key, for example ONB-9.

tools.name: find_mentions
tools.description: Where a task is mentioned in this project: other tasks' descriptions and comments that name its key, with the words around it.

key.description: The task's key, for example ONB-9.

tools.name: recent_activity
tools.description: What changed in this project recently, newest first: status changes, comments, submissions, reviews, assignments and changed dates, with who did it and when (up to 40 entries).

days.description: How many days back to look (default 7).

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search this project's approved documents (specifications, meeting notes, decisions) for passages about a topic. Returns at most 5 passages, best match first, each with its document and section. Only documents an owner or manager approved are searched; drafts never are. Word search: use the words the document would use.

query.description: Words to look for, for example "session timeout" or "refund policy".

tools.name: propose_create_task
tools.description: Suggest a new task. Nothing is created: the person sees the suggestion, can edit it, and decides whether to create it.

dueDate.description: yyyy-MM-dd, only if the person gave a date.

assigneeName.description: Someone on this project, only if the person named them.

tools.name: propose_start_task
tools.description: Suggest starting a task (moving it to In progress). Nothing changes: the person decides.

key.description: The task's key, for example ONB-10.
